PROP-57888860-pre-002.text: All input list lengths must be equal before batch verification proceeds.
PROP-57888860-pre-002.assertion: forall verify_batch(comms, indices, cells, proofs): len(comms) == len(indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs)

locations.note: Validates commitment_indices, cell_indices, cells, and proofs_bytes all have equal length
Asserts commitment_indices.len() == bit_reversed_proofs.len(), bit_reversed_coset_indices.len() == bit_reversed_proofs.len(), bit_reversed_coset_evals.len() == bit_reversed_proofs.len()
